statement.zh: 有学者将杰尔万石砌渡槽表述为罗马之前罕见/未知类型的早期渡槽工程；比较史「世界最早」排名仍属解释性主张。
statement.en: Some scholarship frames the Jerwan stone aqueduct as a type rare or unknown elsewhere before Roman times; comparative ‘world’s first’ rankings remain interpretive.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / comparative ranking — not a closed chronological fact. Other Near Eastern waterworks may be relevant; keep in hypothesis column.
